name: portracker
description: An open source, self-hosted, real-time port monitoring and discovery tool.
readme_summary: Portracker is an open-source, self-hosted tool that automatically discovers and monitors network ports and services across your systems. It provides a real-time, accurate map of your network, preventing manual tracking and deployment issues.
primary_use_case: Real-time network port and service discovery and monitoring for self-hosted environments.
cover_image_prompt: A vigilant network cartographer standing at a crossroads, holding a magical spyglass that reveals glowing lines and icons representing active network ports and services on a stylized map of interconnected servers and containers. The spyglass's light illuminates the discovered elements, while a small, unobtrusive digital interface in the corner displays live data streams and a 'portracker' logo. The scene is set in a cozy, dimly lit study, emphasizing the self-hosted nature, with subtle digital particles flowing from the spyglass. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a clean, modern aesthetic and a vibrant, informative color palette.

name: MangoDisk
description: Safety-first disk cleaner and space analyzer for macOS and Windows, with duplicate cleanup, app uninstall, startup management, system optimization, and maintenance.
readme_summary: MangoDisk is a cross-platform desktop application for macOS and Windows designed to clean up disk space and analyze storage usage. It offers features like deep cleanup of system and application caches, large file identification, duplicate file removal, and privacy data clearing.
key_features: Deep Cleanup (System, App Caches, Browser Data, Developer Tools, Containers, AI Models)
primary_use_case: To help users free up disk space and understand their storage usage on macOS and Windows through a comprehensive and safe cleaning and analysis tool.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly, anthropomorphic mango character, acting as a meticulous librarian, is organizing a vast, cluttered digital library. The librarian is carefully sorting through overflowing shelves of data (represented by glowing blocks and files), identifying and neatly boxing up 'junk' data like old caches and duplicate books. Other shelves are clearly labeled 'Large Files' and 'Private Records' which are being handled with extra care. A large, interactive treemap visualization of the library's layout is subtly displayed on a nearby wall, showing areas of high density. The scene is bright and clean, with a touch of digital sparkle, conveying efficiency and safety. The overall style is a charming 3D isometric illustration with a focus on clear visual storytelling.

name: openscad
description: OpenSCAD - The Programmers Solid 3D CAD Modeller
readme_summary: OpenSCAD is a free software for creating solid 3D CAD objects using a script-based approach. It functions as a 3D compiler, reading script files to render models, making it ideal for machine parts and parametric designs.
key_features: Exports to STL and OFF formats
primary_use_case: Creating precise, parametric 3D models for technical and mechanical purposes through a code-like scripting interface.
cover_image_prompt: A master architect meticulously assembling intricate 3D blueprints from lines of code, like a digital sculptor. The scene shows glowing lines of code on a holographic screen transforming into physical gears, brackets, and mechanical components that assemble themselves into a complex machine. Subtle UI elements displaying the OpenSCAD logo and code snippets are visible. The overall mood is one of precision and creation, with a clean, modern aesthetic and a focus on the transformation from abstract code to tangible objects. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a cool color palette and sharp, clear details.

name: CodeFormer
description: [NeurIPS 2022] Towards Robust Blind Face Restoration with Codebook Lookup Transformer
readme_summary: CodeFormer is a PyTorch-based framework for robust blind face restoration, utilizing a Codebook Lookup Transformer. It excels at enhancing degraded facial images, including those with low resolution, noise, or artifacts, and also supports inpainting and colorization tasks.
key_features: Supports various degradation types (low resolution, noise, artifacts)
Integration with Hugging Face, Replicate, and OpenXLab for demos
primary_use_case: Restoring and enhancing the quality of degraded or low-resolution facial images.
cover_image_prompt: A digital alchemist in a dimly lit, high-tech laboratory, holding a cracked and faded photograph of a face. With a glowing, intricate wand, the alchemist is channeling streams of luminous code and digital particles towards the photograph. The face in the photograph is visibly sharpening, colors are becoming vibrant, and details are emerging as if being painted by light. In the background, subtle holographic displays show before-and-after comparisons and abstract representations of codebooks. The overall mood is one of magical transformation and technological precision, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with a focus on glowing effects and sharp details.

name: tegaki
description: Handwriting animation for the web. Supports any font or text.
readme_summary: Tegaki is a TypeScript library that animates any font into handwriting, creating a stroke-by-stroke drawing effect for the web. It supports various frameworks and offers a command-line interface for generating animated SVGs.
key_features: No manual path authoring or native dependencies
Supports multiple frameworks (React, Svelte, Vue, SolidJS, Astro, Vanilla JS, Web Components)
Bundled handwriting fonts for various languages
Interactive studio for custom font bundles
primary_use_case: To create engaging, animated handwriting effects for text content on websites and in digital presentations.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical animation studio where a magical quill pen, labeled 'Tegaki', is automatically writing text onto a blank canvas. The quill draws letter by letter, with each stroke appearing as if by hand. The input is a simple text prompt displayed on a nearby digital screen, and the output is a beautifully animated script flowing onto the canvas. Subtle glowing digital particles emanate from the quill, hinting at the underlying code. The scene is bright and clean, with a focus on the creative process. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, inviting lighting and a vibrant color palette.

name: mcp-searxng
description: Private web search for AI assistants via SearXNG — supports Claude, Cursor, and any MCP client
readme_summary: This repository acts as an intermediary server, enabling AI assistants like Claude and Cursor to perform web searches through a SearXNG instance. It translates AI assistant requests into SearXNG queries and returns the results, facilitating privacy-respecting web access for AI.
key_features: Integrates SearXNG API for AI web search
Search with pagination, filters, direct answers
Read HTML, structured text, and bounded PDF text
Discover instance capabilities and get query suggestions
primary_use_case: To provide AI assistants with privacy-respecting web search capabilities by connecting them to a SearXNG instance.
cover_image_prompt: A wise owl, representing an AI assistant, perched on a branch. In its talons, it holds a glowing digital scroll that unfurls to reveal a map of the internet. The owl is looking towards a discreet, private library entrance labeled 'SearXNG', from which streams of organized information (represented by glowing data packets) are flowing towards the owl. Subtle UI elements showing search queries and results are visible on small, floating screens around the owl. The scene is set in a serene, moonlit forest, emphasizing privacy and knowledge discovery. The overall style is a 3D isometric illustration with a soft, ethereal glow and a color palette of deep blues and greens.
